text:
Elliot K: Heads-up: onboarding sample-app hit a weird rerank edge where retries + batching helper produced 0-len vectors and then SDK mapped responses by index -> wrong results.
Nina P: Noted. Is this the same dim-mismatch/padding issue?
Elliot K: Related but different. Sequence: (1) initial batch with 3 items, one item had empty vector from storage; (2) server 400 for that item; (3) retry sent only 2 items in a different order; (4) SDK zipped responses back to original indexes.
Ravi M: Oof. So ordering changed mid-flight. SDK assumed stable ordering -> attribution bug.
Elliot K: Exactly. Also saw returned body use `embedding` singular for one model and `embeddings` for another, so parser was brittle.
Nina P: Two vectors of work: make batching helper preserve stable ids + validate shapes; make SDK tolerant of field names.
Ravi M: Agreed. Quick proposal: attach a per-item uuid `request_id` in the batch payload and have server echo it in results. SDK should map by that, not by index.
Elliot K: Will that require server change? we can do a client-side mapping for now by enriching the request with temp ids in metadata.
Nina P: Also: retry policy must not re-enqueue items that failed with 4xx validation. Retries should be for 5xx/timeouts only.
Ravi M: I'll update node batching helper: strict validator on enqueue (Array.isArray + length === EXPECTED_DIM), and return a clear error instead of letting retry swallow it.
Elliot K: Nice. For Python helper we already raise ValueError on bad dims. Node was permissive.
Nina P: And add a small sanitizer option: pad/truncate with a config flag `sanitizeVectors: true/false` so teams can opt into automatic patching, but default should be strict.
Ravi M: Good call. I'll add deterministic pad/truncate with console.warn when triggered.
Elliot K: Regarding response formats, let's implement a tiny compatibility shim: `getEmbeddings(resp) => resp.embeddings || resp.embedding || resp.vectors || []`. Also coerce string numbers -> floats via map(Number).
Nina P: Add unit tests: simulate empty vector in batch, simulate reorder on retry, ensure mapping by id, ensure no retry on 4xx.
Ravi M: I'll add tests and a changelog note.
doc-bot: Suggestion: update quickstart snippet to show pre-send validation and sanitizer example.
Elliot K: I pushed a hotfix to sample-app that validates before enqueue and surfaces a user-friendly error instead of crashing. Link: https://git.internal/repo/sample-app/commit/9b7a2
Nina P: Can we also log to Sentry with `rerank.batch.invalid_vector` so we can catch customer patterns?
Ravi M: Good idea. I'll add a breadcrumb and metric.
ci-bot: CI update: suppressed retries for 4xx in integration test runner, added jittered backoff to reduce duplicate-batch races.
Elliot K: Thanks. Once PRs land we should mention this in the SDK release notes under 'breaking: stricter vector validation (opt-in sanitizer)'.
Nina P: I'll draft the doc blurb + sample sanitizer snippet for Node/Py.
Ravi M: Will open PRs today.
Elliot K: Closing loop here, ping me if you need the trace logs from the sample-app (I left debug prints with request_ids).
